news.title: ZURLICA opens expression of interest for postgraduate research supervision
news.summary: ZURLICA invites prospective MSc and PhD students to submit research interests aligned with AI, big data analytics, machine learning, and business intelligence.

news.title: Planning meeting held for Swahili Language AI workshop
news.summary: ZURLICA convened an internal planning session for a future workshop on low-resource NLP, speech technologies, and multilingual analytics.

news.title: Preliminary fisheries analytics dataset under development
news.summary: The data engineering group is compiling a preliminary dataset to support research on small-scale fisheries, catch prediction, and marine resource management.

news.title: ZURLICA initiates collaboration discussions with regional health researchers
news.summary: Discussions are underway to develop joint projects on health data analytics, maternal health risk prediction, and responsible AI governance.

news.title: ZURLICA website launched as part of laboratory establishment
news.summary: The Zanzibar University Research Lab for Intelligent Computing and Analytics has launched its public website to support research visibility, collaboration, and postgraduate recruitment.
